name: skill-miner
title_zh: 翻你的历史会话，挖出该做成 Skill 的重复动作
tagline_zh: 你已经在同一件事上重复问了 Agent 十几次，只是没人替你数过。它扫会话记录。
tagline_en: You've re-explained the same workflow a dozen times without noticing. It scans session logs, archived transcripts.
desc_en: Use when mining coding-agent session history, archived transcripts, memories, or repeated local work to discover recurring workflows that should become new Agent Skills.
why_zh: 先数证据再下结论：每个候选都挂着出现频次和原文引用，凑不够次数的不进清单，避免凭印象造 Skill。
why_en: Evidence before verdicts: every candidate carries a frequency count and quoted source, so low-signal habits never make the list.
limit_zh: 只读本机已有的会话记录和归档文件，没有历史就没有产出；它只给候选清单和证据，不替你写 Skill 正文；跨机器。
limit_en: Reads only local session logs and archives you already have; no history, no output. It hands you a ranked candidate list with evidence, not finished.
title_en: Mines your past agent sessions for workflows worth turning.
